passages.provision_quote: or has the effect of prohibiting, the connection or reconnection of an energy utility service
passages.note: Bill text is a preemption measure barring local restriction of utility connections; it does not address fossil-fuel production or drilling levels.
Cullimore voted Yea on final passage of HB0017, a utility-connection preemption bill; the vote does not speak to fossil-fuel production levels.

rows.reasoning: The only source is HB0017 (2021), which bars municipalities and counties from restricting the connection of energy utility services, plus Cullimore's Yea vote on its final passage. This decides which level of government may regulate utility connections, not the production or drilling levels the fossil-fuels rungs differ on, so per the preemption rule it is adjacent rather than on-question and cannot support a chair.
